newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged on Wednesday, dealers said.

Tuesday, October raws closed at 10.97 cents per lb, down 0.15 cent on the day, having ranged from 11.12 to 10.95 cents. Second-position March fell 0.10 to 11.16 cents, while the back months finished 0.03 to 0.08 cent lower.
An estimated 23,523 lots changed hands on the day.
Traders said speculative selling could pressure October to the key 10.95-10.90 area, but trade buying is expected to prevent the contract from slipping below its downside target.

LIFFE white sugar futures were mixed on on Wednesday with the spot August contract up sharply ahead of today's expiry. At 0840 EDT/1240 GMT, LIFFE August stood $2.50 firmer at $329.90, while October eased 30 cents to $316.90.
